## Context / Problem
The cross-ticket overlap detector specified by ADR 0086 was switched off in this project on 2026-08-27 and 2026-08-31 (tickets eyeable-intimate-marmoset 62ab and horrendous-limpid-chamois 4eae) because its persistence and coordination design, a write-path enrichment queue that persisted digests and queue events on the shared `tickets` branch, produced write storms, lock contention, and unbounded store growth (105,197 of 147,074 event files are its sidecars). The operator ruled on 2026-09-06 that the retrieval pattern is right and the architecture underneath it is wrong: the implementation is removed, the store must keep parsing every historical event, the create-time same-title journal is re-enabled, and the redesign lives in a separate design-record epic. This is part of pre-1.0 breaking pass #4 and ships with release notes.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] No overlap or enrichment code path runs on any store write, plan review, or CLI invocation: the modules, the `enrich` verb, the 13 `[llm] overlap_*` keys and their env vars, the two prompts, the two schemas, and the doctor lock leg are gone. Checked by the grep and CLI assertions in the removal story.
- [x] A store holding all four retired event types (`TICKET_DIGEST`, `ENQUEUE_ENRICH`, `CLAIM_ENRICH`, `DONE_ENRICH`) still reduces, compacts, and passes `fsck`. Checked by the regression test the removal story adds.
- [x] The create-time same-title duplicate journal warns again on `rebar create` in this project, gated only by `verify.suggest_duplicate_tickets`. Checked by two creates with the same title within the window.
- [x] Every doc, ADR note, and release-notes entry describes the shipped surface: ADR 0086 carries a retired status pointing at the design-record epic, the event-schema rows say "retired producer", and the release notes list every removed key, env var, and verb with its migration. Checked by the docs story's grep and heading assertions.

## Child decomposition
- Removal story: delivers criteria 1, 2, and 3 (code, config, tests, regenerated artifacts, the regression test).
- Documentation story: delivers criterion 4 (docs sweep, ADR note, release notes, stale comments), depends on the removal story.
